model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата показва сравнение на per-output и per-layer perplexity при различни нива на рядкост, използвайки Wanda. На хоризонталната ос са представени нивата на рядкост, подредени от 10% до 90%, с интервали от 10%. Вертикалната ос показва стойностите на perplexity, които варират от приблизително 5.70 до 88.61, със скала, изглеждаща линейна. Стойностите на perplexity са показани за методите "Per-Output" и "Per-Layer", като всяка колона представлява един метод при дадено ниво на рядкост. Стойността на "Per-Output" варира от 5.70 при схема на рядкост от 10% до 53.41 при 90%, докато стойността на "Per-Layer" варира от 5.70 при 10% до 88.61 при 90%. Най-добрият резултат е показан с удебелен шрифт и е маркиран като "indicated in bold".
model_annotations.Chinese: 此柱状图比较了在不同稀疏率下的out-put和per-layer perplexity。水平轴表示稀疏率，单位为百分比，刻度从0%到80%，以10%的间隔划分，且为线性刻度。垂直轴表示perplexity，标签为“Perplexity”，刻度为线性，范围从5.70到88.610，刻度间隔为1，代表数值刻度。图表呈现两个指标的数据，Per-Output 和 Per-Layer，分别用绿色和蓝色柱状图表示。Per-Output柱状图的范围从5.70到53.412，而在20%稀疏率时值为5.70，而在80%稀疏率时值为53.412。Per-Layer柱状图的范围从5.82到88.610，在20%稀疏率时值为5.82，在80%稀疏率时值为88.610。图表中的Per-Output指标在每个稀疏率点上都比Per-Layer指标值低。图表按稀疏率的递增顺序排列，并且颗粒状的Per-Layer柱状图在0%稀疏率时(5.82 perplexity)被加粗显示，表明其代表了最佳结果。
model_annotations.English: Figure 5 illustrates a comparison of per-output and per-layer perplexity at different sparsity rates, using WandB. The chart displays two sets of bars, one for “Per-Output” and the other for “Per-Layer,” arranged side-by-side across six sparsity rate categories. The horizontal axis represents sparsity rates, ranging from 10% to 80% in 10% increments, labeled as 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, and 80%. The vertical axis represents perplexity, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 90, with tick labels at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, and 90. The "Per-Output" bars are colored blue, while the "Per-Layer" bars are colored orange. The "Per-Output" bars demonstrate a trend of increasing height from approximately 5.70 at 10% sparsity to approximately 53.41 at 80% sparsity. The "Per-Layer" bars also show an increasing trend, starting at approximately 5.70 at 10% sparsity and reaching a height of approximately 88.61 at 80% sparsity. The bars representing 70% sparsity are visually emphasized, being displayed in bold. Notably, the value at 50% sparsity for “Per-Layer” is 7.17, which is indicated as the "best performance result" with a notation. The bars are sorted in ascending order according to the sparsity rate.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Balkendiagramm vergleicht Per-Output- und Per-Layer-Perplexitätswerte bei unterschiedlichen Sparsity-Raten unter Verwendung von WandG. Die horizontale Achse stellt die Sparsity-Rate dar, ab 10 % bis 80 %, in Schritten von 20 % angezeigt. Die vertikale Achse stellt die Perplexität dar, die von 0 bis 88,6 auf einer linearen Skala reicht, wobei die Ticks in Intervallen von 10 angezeigt werden. Es gibt zwei Farbsegmente von Balken: Ein hellgrüner Balkensatz stellt Per-Output dar und ein blauer Balkensatz stellt Per-Layer dar. Die Per-Output-Balken haben beispielsweise bei 10 % Sparsity einen Wert von 5,70, bei 20 % einen Wert von 5,99 und bei 80 % einen Wert von 53,41. Die Per-Layer-Balken haben bei 10 % eine Perplexität von 5,70, bei 20 % eine Perplexität von 5,82 und bei 80 % eine Perplexität von 88,61. Die Balken für Per-Output bei 50 % Sparsity sind in Fettschrift hervorgehoben.
